rule: One row per player per game. Minutes, points, rebounds and assists are read from the official gamebook row; a row is stored only when it assembles into 16 numeric cells, otherwise it is recorded in `problems` and excluded. Team point totals and minute totals are asserted against the gamebook's own team line.

minutes_check.note: Each player's MM:SS is rounded to the second by the document, so a team's per-player minutes need not sum to exactly 240:00. The tolerance is 5 s per team; the residual is published rather than corrected. HOU is the one team outside it because four of its rows print a short row (see `problems`) and are excluded rather than guessed at.

HOU@MIA.plus_minus_identity: five players are on the floor at all times, so the individual +/- cells must sum to 5 x the team margin: complete rows sum to -80, the four short rows to -10, total -90, and 5 x -18 = -90 — they agree
HOU@MIA.conclusion: every hypothesis except TOT contradicts the gamebook's own printed team totals by many columns; TOT leaves only a +1 residual on assists and +1 on steals. That is strong evidence and NOT proof, so no value is written into `rows` — the four players stay excluded and their minutes (the unambiguous cell) are the only figures republished.
